Name: Exotic Animals for Alternative Textures
Author: DGlaky
Description:
Adds sprites from Exotic Animals using the Alternative Textures mod. These sprites can be applied using Scissors, which can be bought from Robin's shop for 500g 

Includes-

Void Cow,
Merchant Pig,
Merchant Goat,
Pink Rabbit,
Speed Rooster
